final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e."aCL IgM" AS igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(igm) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.ID, s.SEX, s.igm, s.igm - a.overall_avg AS deviation FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS a WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS sex_avg FROM step3 GROUP BY SEX) SELECT s.ID, s.SEX, s.igm, s.deviation, s.deviation - g.sex_avg FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS g ON s.SEX = g.SEX WHERE s.deviation > g.sex_avg ORDER BY s.deviation - g.sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10
